appearance: A seventeen-year-old boy with a sharp, clever kind of handsomeness—lean and restless, the sort of beauty that comes from quick hands and quicker thinking. His dark brown hair is messy and unruly, falling forward into his face in thick, uneven locks that he clearly doesn't bother to tame, partially obscuring his brow and brushing the tops of his cheekbones. His face is narrow and angular, still holding the last traces of adolescence in the softer line of his jaw, and his eyes are a striking bright green, almond-shaped and slightly narrowed, set beneath straight dark brows. His mouth rests in a slight smirk, pulled to one side as if perpetually amused or skeptical. His skin is light with a healthy matte finish, clean and smooth. He is slim and wiry, the build of someone who moves often and eats lightly, with narrow shoulders and long limbs that suggest he hasn't quite finished growing into his frame. He stands with his weight shifted onto one leg, one hand resting near his belt, the other hanging loosely at his side, his gaze meeting the viewer directly with a level, measuring look. He wears a plain grey tunic and dark trousers, simple and unadorned. Full body, head to toe, against a plain grey background.
